scenes.vo: Một người mua đến trễ bốn mươi lăm phút, rồi ngồi suốt hai tiếng, cân từng gói thẻ Pokémon trên chiếc cân nữ trang của người khác, như nhà giả kim đang thử vàng.
scenes.gloss: A buyer shows up forty-five minutes late, then sits for two hours weighing every Pokémon pack on someone else's jewellery scale, like an alchemist testing gold.
scenes.viewer: A late buyer weighs every pack on a tiny scale for hours.
scenes.build: new: the living room (door, clock, calendar, table, scale, lamp, two pack stacks).
scenes.blocking: Dealer bursts through the door f10, walks (side view, -x) behind the table to his chair f16-54, sits f56-66 at his mark facing +z.
scenes.action: f0-10 the clock over the door already reads 45 min late (hands spin through 45 min f0-50, title 45 PHÚT); f10-16 the door flies open and slams the wall on 'trễ' (f20): kick, a framed photo by the door rattles; f56-66 he drops into the chair; f70 sets the borrowed scale square; f77-106 the clock spins two hours on 'suốt hai tiếng' (title 120 PHÚT); f107-200 three weigh cycles: pack from the right stack onto the pan, readout ticks (21.4 g, 21.1 g, 22.9 g), pack onto the left stack; f208-262 he lifts a pack against the lamp, a loupe at his eye, the scale's readout glows gold on 'vàng' (f250).
scenes.acting: Dealer unhurried, smug, squinting; never looks up.

cams.why: the door bursts open under the clock
he sits, the clock spins two hours

marks.pose: walk in f16-54, sit f56, weigh f107-200, pack to the lamp f208

scenes.physics: Door: swings 0 -> 100 deg in 5 f, hits the stop, bounces back 12 deg and settles 95 deg by f30 (damped spring). Packs: carried, set down flat; the stacks grow / shrink by one each cycle.
scenes.light_mood: golden evening: warm lamp, the scale's LCD and the lamp bulb emissive.
scenes.sound: door slam f16 (Instagram Thud); clock ticking fast f0-50 and f77-106; scale beep each weigh f118, f150, f182; a mystic shimmer on 'vàng' f250.
scenes.after: The packs move from the right stack to the left stack; the dealer stays at the table.
